title: Puharich's journal lists the names of the space kids

tellings.quote: actually in fact, in one of his journals he like wrote all the names of the kids at the time.

plain: In the 1970s, Andrija Puharich, a researcher described on the show as a CIA scientist who contacted an alien council, is said to have written down in one of his journals the names of all the children known as the "space kids". A researcher who is not named in the episode tells Michels this from reading Puharich's journals. It matters because it would put on paper who those children were.
